# Monona Coach

> Find why your shot is inconsistent, compare mechanics to pro forms, and get drills for release timing, balance, elbow path, and follow-through. Free on iOS.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://monona-sports.com/): Product overview, form analysis, testimonials, FAQ, and download.
- [Download on iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/monona-coach/id6754575963): Free Monona Coach app on the Apple App Store.

## Site pages

- [Book a demo](https://monona-sports.com/book-demo.html): Schedule a call to see the app in action.
- [Team](https://monona-sports.com/team.html): Co-founders Ti Wu (Diego) and Raphael (Hyuntaek) Oh.
- [Privacy Notice](https://monona-sports.com/privacy.html): How Monona Coach collects and uses data.
- [Linktree](https://monona-sports.com/linktree/): Social links and quick actions for bio pages.

## Homepage sections

- [Fix your form](https://monona-sports.com/#why-monona): AI video analysis to find why your shot is inconsistent.
- [Features](https://monona-sports.com/#features): NBA comparison, AI coaching, personalized drills, and analytics.
- [Who it's for](https://monona-sports.com/#who-its-for): Players, parents, trainers, and AAU coaches.
- [How it works](https://monona-sports.com/#how-it-works): Record, analyze, compare, and improve in four steps.
- [Compare options](https://monona-sports.com/#compare): AI shooting coach vs shot tracker vs human coach.
- [FAQ](https://monona-sports.com/#faq): Common questions about Monona Coach as an AI basketball shooting coach.
- [Download](https://monona-sports.com/#download): Get the free iOS app.
